g.text: The fastest checkmate in chess — just 2 moves.
The classic 4-move trap that punishes weak defence.
The knight strikes — king trapped by his own men.
The pawns become a wall — and a coffin.
Knight controls escape, rook delivers the blow.
Two bishops criss-cross — the classic double diagonal.
